capabilities: Fetch Douyin favorites and import them as Markdown notes
Download videos and generate Whisper speech transcripts in Heavy mode
Schedule daily automatic syncs with retry and deduplication
Show backend connection state and sync progress in the status bar
Configure note, attachment, and sync-mode settings
extras: Desktop only because it uses Node.js fs to copy attachments; the community review flags a Direct Filesystem Access warning, which the README explains in detail. Includes a disclaimer that users are responsible for complying with Douyin's Terms of Service. Heavy mode requires downloading a Whisper model on first run.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import Douyin favorites as notes with their media and transcripts.

relations.evidence: This plugin communicates with a local Python backend service. Please set up douyin-favorites-sync-backend first.
Download watermark-free videos + Whisper speech transcription

summary: Plugin that syncs Douyin favorites into Obsidian notes with captions, tags, covers, videos, and Whisper transcripts via a local Python backend.
